items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: So it made a big impression on you. Then in ‘48, when school ended, you drove to Illinois, drove north, you went to Chicago. You did some jobs around Chicago. You met some people from the Lionel Hampton band. You learned Tadd Dameron’s “Half Nelson.” Then I guess more of the same when you went back to Mississippi. Then, in the summer of ‘49, you were hired full-time to play piano and trumpet, and I guess sing as well, at Lake Taneycomo in the Ozarks, which is where you and your wife met.
